name: smart-hospital-platform
description: Smart Hospital Management & Appointment Platform Monorepo

scripts.build: npm run build:common && npm run build:services
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "GATEWAY,AUTH,PATIENT,DOCTOR,APPOINTMENT,BILLING,NOTIF,CLIENT" -c "magenta,blue,cyan,green,yellow,red,gray,white" "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:patient" "npm run dev:doctor" "npm run dev:appointment" "npm run dev:billing" "npm run dev:notification" "npm run dev:client"
